Features

Everything your shop needs, in one place

Designed around how D Speedway really works, from the parts shelf to the service bay to the cashier.

📦

Inventory Management

Add, update and track parts, oils and supplies with automatic stock deduction on every sale.

🧾

Point of Sale

Fast, accurate billing for parts and services with printable receipts and clear transaction history.

🔧

Service Tracking

Record wheel alignment, oil change, balancing, chassis repair and aircon jobs per customer and vehicle.

🔔

Low-Stock Alerts

Get notified before a popular item runs out, so you never lose a sale for being empty-handed.

📊

Sales Reports

Daily, weekly and monthly reports on revenue, best sellers and service performance.

🔐

Secure Access Roles

Separate logins for owner, cashier and staff so every person only sees what they should.

A dashboard that shows your whole business
